backward_filter_verdict.why: the R2 edge's ell is not fixed across the branches -- it is 0 at all nine ell=4 known boundaries and 5 at all three ell=0 ones -- so no single predecessor class exists to filter against. The Phi budget already encodes the only sound consequence: an R2 edge of length ell costs 5-ell of Phi, so a root with Phi = ell_root + 1 can only afford R2 edges with ell >= 4 - ell_root.
